fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-09-09, the owner of Arasu Furniture reported repeated demands for weekly payments of Rs. 3,000 from persons visiting the premises near Nallur Park Main Street. The time of the incident was given as 11:45 on 2025-09-09. The online submission was made by Praveen Anand (9000000419). The complainant is associated with the business Arasu Furniture. A witness, Rajesh Rajan, reachable on 9000000302, was mentioned in the complaint. The complaint refers to another person whose identity could not be established. The complainant alleged that Hariharan Palanisamy may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000463. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and a call detail reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00182, as the mobile number 9000000463 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspects allegedly visited the premises and demanded regular payments.
fields.Keywords: extortion, business, CCTV, call detail, suspect, witness, mobile number, main street
